test_root_newton_raphson_basic: test the Newton-Raphson root finder with positive and negative search directions against scipy.optimize.root
create_root_newton_raphson: create a differentiable Newton-Raphson root finder using jax_root_finding.root_newton_raphson with custom tolerance and max iterations
build_root_metadata: build a RootMetadata dataclass containing iterations, residual, last_tau, and error fields for solver diagnostics
test_gradient_correctness: test gradient correctness of the root finder through jax.grad on a loss function composed with the solver
run_jit_root_finding: run the root finder under jax.jit with static_argnames for tol and maxiter parameters
